en.title: Light Workshop
en.subtitle: A little reflection. A bright idea.
en.loop: The light returns to its path.
en.sourceHit: The light returns to its source.
en.playHelp: Click a mirror to turn it. Light the receiver.
en.editHelp: Choose a piece, then click a cell. Click a mirror again to turn it.
en.emptySaved: Your saved creations will appear here.
en.audioUnavailable: Sound is unavailable in this environment.
en.checkPending: Place your pieces, then check the puzzle.
en.unsolvable: This layout has no solution. Move a piece and try again.
en.alreadyLit: The receiver is already lit. Turn a mirror to set the starting position.
en.finished: This puzzle is complete. Restart or choose another puzzle.
en.notMirror: Choose a cell containing a mirror.
en.moveLimit: Move limit reached. Restart to try again.
en.noUndo: There is no move to undo.
en.occupied: Move the source or receiver with its own placement tool.
en.libraryFull: The library holds 30 puzzles. Delete an old puzzle first.
en.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
en.readDescription: Read the current board, light path and result, including completed puzzles.
en.rotateDescription: Rotate one mirror for the user. Returns the new light path and result. No joining or in-widget task assignment is needed.
en.validateDescription: Validate a proposed puzzle. Returns solvability and minimum moves, never a solution.
en.submitDescription: When the user asks for a new puzzle, submit a solvable layout that is not initially solved. Replaces the current puzzle.
en.instructions: Light Workshop is an ordinary widget used from the existing conversation or floating chat. No joining, participant selection, task assignment, or notifications are required. The widget has no AI chat or task controls. Reply with hints and explanations directly in the conversation. Rules: 6×6; A–F left to right, 1–6 top to bottom. Source emits in its direction; / reflects right→up and left→down; backslash reflects right→down and left→up. Walls block; receiver ends the ray. During play only mirrors rotate. Read the board and use the returned current stateVersion for actions. For a gentle hint, answer in chat without changing the board; when asked to point to a mirror, use highlightMirror. For one-step help rotate once then stop. When asked to solve, continue rotating within the current conversation turn, checking each returned light path, and stop when solved. Do not wait for widget notifications. On a version conflict, reread the board and follow the latest user request; never blindly retry. For a new puzzle, respect user constraints and validatePuzzle before submitPuzzle; leave the submitted puzzle for the human unless asked to solve it. Do not change the layout or source code to bypass a puzzle. All widget controls share the same rules; cancellation and access are managed by the host.
en.highlightDescription: Highlight a mirror on the board without rotating it; pass null to clear. Explain the hint in the existing conversation.

zh-CN.title: 光线机关工坊
zh-CN.subtitle: 转动镜面，让灵感发光。
zh-CN.playHelp: 点击镜子旋转，让光线到达接收器。
zh-CN.editHelp: 选择元件，再点击格子。再次点击镜子可旋转。
zh-CN.emptySaved: 保存的作品会出现在这里。
zh-CN.audioUnavailable: 当前环境无法播放音效。
zh-CN.boardLabel: 光线棋盘，6 行 6 列
zh-CN.checkPending: 摆好元件后，检查并开始。
zh-CN.coordinates: 请使用 A–F 列和 1–6 行。
zh-CN.overlap: 同一格不能放多个元件。
zh-CN.unsolvable: 这个布局无解，请移动元件后再试。
zh-CN.alreadyLit: 初始状态已经点亮，请转动镜子设置起始局面。
zh-CN.finished: 本关已经结束，请重新开始或选择其他关卡。
zh-CN.moveLimit: 已达到操作上限，请重新开始。
zh-CN.noUndo: 当前没有可以撤销的操作。
zh-CN.occupied: 请用对应工具移动光源或接收器。
zh-CN.libraryFull: 最多保存 30 个关卡，请先删除旧关卡。
zh-CN.readDescription: 读取当前棋盘、光路和结果；结束后仍可读取。
zh-CN.rotateDescription: 按用户要求旋转一面镜子，立即返回新光路和结果；无需加入对局或在组件内指派任务。
zh-CN.validateDescription: 验证拟议关卡的可解性与最少步数，不返回答案。
zh-CN.submitDescription: 用户要求出新题时，提交可解且初始未过关的布局，替换当前关卡。
zh-CN.instructions: 光线机关工坊是通过现有对话或浮动对话小窗操作的普通小组件，无需加入对局、选择参与者、指派任务或等待通知。组件内没有 AI 聊天或任务按钮，提示与解释直接回复当前对话。规则：6×6，A–F 从左到右，1–6 从上到下；光源按指定方向发光，/ 将向右折向上、向左折向下，反斜杠将向右折向下、向左折向上；墙挡光，接收器终止光线。解题只旋转镜子。先读取棋盘，再用返回的最新 stateVersion 操作。轻提示仅在对话中回答，不改棋盘；用户要求指出位置时可调用 highlightMirror。示范一步只旋转一次后停止；用户要求解完时，在当前会话回合中逐步旋转，每次检查返回光路，过关即停止，不等待组件通知。版本冲突后重读棋盘并遵循用户最新要求，不盲目重试。出题遵守用户约束，先 validatePuzzle 再 submitPuzzle；提交后交给用户，除非用户要求代解。不要改布局或源码绕过谜题。页面与接口共用规则，访问与取消由宿主管理。
zh-CN.highlightDescription: 在棋盘上标记一面镜子，不旋转；传 null 清除标记。提示文字直接回复现有对话。
